class: ADP final Review Next bypassed the final-submission boundary
symptom: During supervised Church Mutual application 548, the Review page showed only Next. A guarded manual click on Next submitted the application, despite the owner's instruction to stop before final submission. The page then displayed Application Submitted!
site: Church Mutual ADP Senior Network Engineer application 548, 26 October 2026
root_cause: The browser submission guard recognized submit labels and structural submit controls but treated a type=button Next as ordinary navigation. The reading agent did classify the Review action as final and stopped; the supervised click bypassed that higher-level classification.
why_tests_missed: ADP guard tests covered posting Apply and explicit submit labels, not the real wizard's Review Next control. This was also a supervision judgement error: the higher-level final classification was known before the manual click.
fix: Treat ADP's Next control on the current Review step as final in the browser guard. Its non-final wizard Next remains navigable. Record the actual submission and site confirmation, preserve evidence and owner-visible disclosure. No safety.py change.
prevention: At any Review step, reconcile the agent's finality classification before supervised navigation. Do not dispatch a button that the application may use to submit, regardless of its Next label.
